newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-FRENCH CUP FINAL ALREADY SOLD OUT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FRENCH CUP FINAL ALREADY SOLD OUT.

text.p: The French Cup Final between Nice and Guingamp at the 48,712-capacity Parc des Princes stadium in Paris on May 14 has been sold out, the French Football Federation said.

Relegated Nice, who won the cup twice during their glory years in the 1950s, are in their fourth final against Guingamp, a small-town club who have been in the first division only two seasons and had never before progressed beyond the quarter-finals.
